_what_this_pins: The RICH payload: 39 resources whose tags.environment was rewritten by ONE policy Modify effect (drift-inherit-environment), plus one genuinely out-of-band Contributor grant, plus two reconciled runtime-named rows. Taken from a real rg-drift-test scan. This is the only fixture with policy_enforced_properties, and the only one that can catch a narrative splitting one cause into N findings: the word budget scales with the finding count, so 39 near-identical headings stay inside it and no mechanical check would notice. Claude got this right unprompted (one finding, 'LOW x 39 - one story, many resources'); the prompt now says so explicitly, and this fixture is how we tell whether that still holds.
